name: Boromir's Cloak
game_text:
Bearer must be Boromir.
<phase>Maneuver</phase>: Exert Boromir to discard a weather condition.
flavor_text: “He was cloaked and booted as if for a journey on horseback; and indeed though his garments were rich, and his cloak was lined with fur, they were stained with long travel.”
